description: This file declares internal functions and structures for system event messaging, including message creation, sending, receiving, and utility functions related to system events in a C project.

methods.name: SE_print_message
methods.description: Prints a system event message based on message content and type.

methods.name: SE_string2size
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes required to store a string in a system event message.

methods.name: SE_print_message_hdr
methods.description: Prints a message header for debugging or logging.

methods.name: SE_msg_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string to a system event message buffer, including size indication and alignment.

methods.name: SE_msg_hdr_mbytes_fixup
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of a message in the message header.

methods.name: SE_msg_receive
methods.description: Receives a message from a file descriptor, returning message type and sender info.

methods.name: SE_minimal_blocking_msg_receive
methods.description: Receives a message with a short wait, returning immediately if no message is available.

methods.name: SE_msg_send
methods.description: Sends a message through a file descriptor.

methods.name: SE_msg_send_receive
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a reply.

methods.name: SE_msg_prepare
methods.description: Creates a new system event message in a buffer.

methods.name: SE_msg_send_data
methods.description: Sends data through a file descriptor.

methods.name: SE_msg_add_data
methods.description: Adds data to a message buffer.
